description: A TLS certificate expires. Instantaneous, total, and unrelated to load.

timeline.message: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid: current time 2026-08-10T00:00:04Z is after 2026-08-09T23:59:59Z

ground_truth.root_cause: The TLS certificate presented by token-issuer.internal expired at 2026-08-09T23:59:59Z. Every auth-service TLS handshake to it now fails verification, so all logins fail. Onset is exactly at expiry, not correlated with load.
ground_truth.distractor_note: A 100% failure rate with a 9.7 z-score can be misread as a load event.
